ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, signal X enters a summing node; the output signal is fed back from below to this summing node, and is subtracted with a negative sign at the summing node. The output of the summing node passes in sequence through gain α and system function block F, finally obtaining output Y. Therefore the figure is a unity negative feedback structure, and the forward path is αF. Reasoning: For a unity negative feedback system, the closed-loop transfer function is Y/X = αF/(1+αF). When α=10, it is known that 10F/(1+10F) = (1+ℛ)/(2+ℛ). Let G=10F, then G/(1+G) = (1+ℛ)/(2+ℛ). Cross-multiplying gives G(2+ℛ) = (1+G)(1+ℛ), and after simplification gives G=1+ℛ, so 10F=1+ℛ. When α=20, 20F = 2(10F) = 2+2ℛ. Therefore the closed-loop transfer function is (20F)/(1+20F) = (2+2ℛ)/(1+2+2ℛ) = (2+2ℛ)/(3+2ℛ). Comparing with the given form (2+2ℛ)/(t+2ℛ), obtain t=3.

method.method_draft: From the diagram, write Y/X = alpha F/(1+alpha F). For alpha=10, set 10F/(1+10F)=(1+R)/(2+R) and solve for 10F, giving 10F=1+R. For alpha=20, the forward path is 20F=2(1+R)=2+2R. Therefore Y/X=(2+2R)/(1+2+2R)=(2+2R)/(3+2R), so compare with (2+2R)/(t+2R) to get t=3.

If $\alpha=10$, then the closed-loop system functional is known to be $$ \left.\frac{Y}{X}\right|_{\alpha=10}=\frac{1+\mathcal{R}}{2+\mathcal{R}}. $$ Determine the closed-loop system functional when $\alpha=20$: $$ \left.\frac{Y}{X}\right|_{\alpha=20}=\frac{2+2\mathcal{R}}{t+2\mathcal{R}}. $$ Find $t$.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, signal X enters a summing node; the output signal is fed back from below to this summing node, and is subtracted with a negative sign at the summing node. The output of the summing node passes in sequence through gain α and system function block F, finally obtaining output Y. Therefore the figure is a unity negative feedback structure, and the forward path is αF. Reasoning: For a unity negative feedback system, the closed-loop transfer function is Y/X = αF/(1+αF). When α=10, it is known that 10F/(1+10F) = (1+ℛ)/(2+ℛ). Let G=10F, then G/(1+G) = (1+ℛ)/(2+ℛ). Cross-multiplying gives G(2+ℛ) = (1+G)(1+ℛ), and after simplification gives G=1+ℛ, so 10F=1+ℛ. When α=20, 20F = 2(10F) = 2+2ℛ. Therefore the closed-loop transfer function is (20F)/(1+20F) = (2+2ℛ)/(1+2+2ℛ) = (2+2ℛ)/(3+2ℛ). Comparing with the given form (2+2ℛ)/(t+2ℛ), obtain t=3.
